[SWS_CM_00083] Call
StopOfferService()
before destruction of Skeleton
⌈
If
the skeleton object is destroyed while a method call is still in progress (using asyn-
chronous handling,
ara::com::MethodCallProcessingMode
==
kEvent
), the be-
havior is undefined. Therefore,
StopOfferService()
should be called either from
the application before the destruction, or within the user defined destructor in the in-
herited skeleton class.
⌋
